craftweave.quantity.tip: How many to make. Type a number (or scroll; shift for a stack), then click the result or press Enter. When the grid runs out, the same recipe is laid out again from your pack. Empty or 1 is the table as usual.
craftweave.cycle.tip: Click for the next, right-click for the previous. Your pick is remembered.
craftweave.bookmark.place: Click to lay it out from your pack (shift: as many as fit)
craftweave.clear: Put everything on the grid back in your pack
